नैवि(बि)ड्यं
1 Compactness,
closeness, thickness, denseness.
--2
Substance.
--3 A continuous sound.

नैवेद्यं An offering of eatables
presented to a deity or idol.

1 Any vessel or
implement forming part of domestic
furniture.
--2 A present to a Brāhmaṇa
householder, e. g. a girl or
ornaments given with her.
